description: Shell command lines and the decision agentin should take about them. 'cwd' names a directory of 'directories'; 'writable' lists the directories where writing is allowed. 'expect' is allow, ask, deny, or agent (agentin leaves the decision to the agent). 'asks' lists the commands an ask names. 'pending' marks behaviour planned for a later stage: the test expects it to fail until then. 'unsupported' marks a line the Bash parser does not support.

cases.command: for d in build cmake-build-debug cmake-build-release; do echo "=== $d"; grep -E "CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE:|CMAKE_GENERATOR:|QCE_BUILD" $d/CMakeCache.txt; done

cases.name: for-build-and-test-then-rm
cases.command: for d in build cmake-build-debug cmake-build-release; do echo "=== $d"; cmake --build $d -j16 2>&1 | grep -E "error|Error|FAILED" | head -20; echo "build rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; (cd $d && ctest 2>&1 | tail -3); done; rm -rf /tmp/qce-build
cases.note: builds in writable directories; rm always asks
